g.text: 4. ITEM 3: blank 52.0 x 50.0 x 10.0; three bosses Ø7.0, 0.3 proud, tops ground in
one plane within 0.005; in each a reamed hole Ø0.6 +0.005 / 0 x 0.5, sharp burr-free
rim, at the pocket positions of the table (+-0.02). The base plate rests on the
bosses only (inside its legend-free zones); clamp: three annular feet over them.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 1. Pocket positions are the ball-foot positions of the marker (YAML base_plate.feet):
(0.0, 15.0), (-16.5, -9.5), (16.5, -9.5) from the marker centre; the visor flat
is at y = 18.4, the round wall at R23.0.
2. Section A-A is cut through nest A with the marker seated (assembly solids of
this build). The fence touches the visor flat between the top of its undercut and
its top; the window recesses start higher (z 4.2).
3. Item 2 in the same section: no pads and no pockets, the balls stand on the face,
the base plate is 0.1 above it.
